_comment: Active hero abilities (units.json -> abilities lists ids in hotkey/button order). kind: aoe_damage = damage_mult x caster damage to every enemy within radius on the LANE (|dx|); dash = burst `distance` px at `speed` px/s along the steer/facing direction with `invuln_s` seconds of i-frames. Cosmetics: sfx id (audio.json) + optional shake.
